creator: Alexander Terp
description:
`./devenv/devenv up` rebuilds the image, but a container that is already running keeps the image it started from. A `devenv/Dockerfile` edit therefore does not reach the container until somebody runs `down` first, and nothing says so.

This is the image version of `a_2LONhlgwh`, which `2c986bf` fixed for the ssh key. Slot 4 of the 2026-09-12 round hit it adding a sudoers rule. Comparing the running container's image id with the one `build` just produced, and recreating on mismatch, would cover it the same way.
title: devenv up leaves a running container on a stale image
